name: Women for Conservation Circle Grant
summary: Seed grants of US$2,000–5,000 for women-led grassroots organisations in the Global South, and for Indigenous-led groups, that protect species on the IUCN Red List and include a women's empowerment component.

geography.label: Global South, or Indigenous-led groups anywhere

calls.label: Rolling applications

status.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

calls.note: The page dates from January 2025 and does not say whether applications are still being taken

applicant_types.quote: We are seeking new global partners-women-led grassroots organizations and Indigenous-led groups that align with our mission of conservation through community-driven efforts.

geography.quote: Be based in the Global South (Latin America, the Caribbean, Africa, the Middle East, Asia, or Oceania) or be an Indigenous-led group.

access.quote: Once completed, please email your application to info@womenforconservation.org.

window.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

amount.quote: Women for Conservation provides seed funding grants ranging from $2,000 to $5,000 USD
